daemon_enabled.description: Run alsaplayer as a background daemon (recommended for headless systems)

run_as_user.description: System username to run the daemon as (for security isolation)

run_as_group.description: System group to run the daemon as (must allow audio device access)

pidfile_path.description: Absolute path to the PID file for process management

log_file.description: Path to write logs to; leave empty to log only to stdout/stderr

net_listen_address.description: IP address to bind HTTP/XML-RPC control interfaces to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for local-only)

http_port.description: TCP port for the HTTP control interface (used by web UIs and clients)

xmlrpc_port.description: TCP port for the XML-RPC remote control interface

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed

auth_username.description: Username for HTTP/XML-RPC authentication (required if auth is enabled)

auth_password.description: Password for HTTP/XML-RPC authentication (required if auth is enabled)

alsa_device.description: ALSA PCM device name (e.g., 'hw:0,0' for first sound card, first device)

alsa_mixer.description: ALSA mixer control name to adjust volume (e.g., 'PCM', 'Speaker')

alsa_mixer_device.description: ALSA mixer device (if different from PCM device); often same as alsa_device

default_volume.description: Initial playback volume (0–100) on start or restart

buffer_time.description: Audio buffer duration in milliseconds (0 = use ALSA default)

prebuffer_percent.description: Prebuffering target as percentage of buffer (0–100); higher = smoother start, longer latency

output_plugins.description: Additional output plugin configurations (for multi-output setups)

name.description: Unique identifier for the output plugin (e.g., 'main', 'backyard')

device.description: ALSA PCM device for this output

type.description: Output plugin type (ALSAPLAYER supports 'alsa' only in core)

decoders.description: Ordered list of decoder plugins to use (e.g., ['ffmpeg', 'sndfile']); empty = all enabled decoders

input_plugins.description: Custom input plugin configurations (e.g., for HTTP stream priority)

priority.description: Priority (0–100) — higher priority plugins are tried first

autoplay.description: Automatically start playback when a track is added to an empty queue
